description_en: Invokes the DeleteVSwitch operation to delete a vSwitch
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-vswitch --vswitch-id vsw-asdfjlna0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteVSwitch

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch that you want to delete
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the vSwitch that you want to delete.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的交换机的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run. The system checks the required parameters, request format, and business restrictions. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): sends a Normal request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation to delete a vSwitch is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会删除交换机。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行删除
parameters.name: dry_run
